methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $15M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 2 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 13 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 20.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Hyfix is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Mike Horton and Udan Ercan that has raised $15M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector contains 11 total peers (3 public: ALAB, NVDA, AMD; 8 private including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched), though narrow peer filtering yields insufficient comparable data at the same stage and valuation tier.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using the $15M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, this method implies a $38M valuation. The Peer-Median approach cannot be applied: while 13 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the minimum threshold of three comparables within the same stage or adjacent-stage bands at similar valuation tiers. Public-Comp Anchoring is inapplicable because Hyfix's revenue is not disclosed; the three public semiconductor comps trade at a 20.4x median P/S, but this multiple cannot be deployed without a target revenue figure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $32M (low, -15% from median) to $43M (high, +15% from median), with $38M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly-filtered private comparables in the seed semiconductor space and the lack of disclosed revenue data, which limits triangulation robustness. Any material update to peer availability or revenue disclosure would warrant recalibration.
